hata.aiGecersizYanit: The device software returned an invalid response (not JSON). Try again; if it continues, send the application logs to the support team.
hata.aiGonderilemedi: The request could NOT BE SENT to the device software (the browser cut the request: the connection dropped, the network changed or the selected file could not be read). If the indicator above says 'Offline', fix the connection first; otherwise select the file again and try again. If it continues, restart the application.
hata.aiInternetGerekir: AI analysis requires the internet. Sessions and emergency stop are not affected.
hata.aiZamanAsimi: The analysis timed out. The FIRST run of a model can take ~30 seconds; it takes even longer if other analyses are running at the same time. Try again — the model is ready now, so this time it will finish quickly.
hata.gondermeHatasi: An error occurred while sending data to the server.
hata.jetonYetersiz: Your credit allowance is insufficient. Sessions and emergency stop are not affected.
hata.sifresizAdres: The device address is unencrypted (http) and not on the local network — the request was not sent.
hata.silmeHatasi: An error occurred while deleting the record on the server.
hata.sunucuIletisim: A problem occurred while communicating with the server.
hata.zamanAsimiGovde: The server did not respond in time. Try again — the first analysis may take a long time because of model loading.
